definitions.explanation: The solid surface of the earth as opposed to the sea or air.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}が{陸|りく}に{着|つ}いた。
{陸|りく}と{海|うみ}の{両方|りょうほう}を{旅|たび}した。
examples.english: I traveled by both land and sea.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{陸|りく}に{近|ちか}づいているので{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful because the typhoon is approaching land.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}は{水|みず}の{中|なか}に{住|す}んでいるが、カエルは{陸|りく}でも{生活|せいかつ}できる。
examples.english: Fish live in water, but frogs can also live on land.

notes:
USAGE: {陸|りく} refers to dry land as opposed to water or air. It's often used in contrast with {海|うみ} (sea) or {空|そら} (sky).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{陸地|りくち} (land, dry land)
・{陸上|りくじょう} (on land, land-based)
・{大陸|たいりく} (continent)
・{陸軍|りくぐん} (army)
・{上陸|じょうりく} (landing, going ashore)
・{陸路|りくろ} (overland route)

RELATED:
・{海|うみ} - sea
・{空|そら} - sky
